summary: Light regression + branding verification pass for LifeOS -> Nannu rebrand. Confirmed app.json is valid JSON with expo.name='Nannu' (bundleId/package/slug correctly untouched). Frontend boots cleanly via web preview with no red-screen errors (only a benign RN-web hydration warning about nested <button> in TouchableOpacity, pre-existing pattern, not related to this change). Favicon.ico returns 200 (no broken icon). All 5 requested in-app text changes verified live via Playwright: More hub footer 'Nannu · v1.0.0', Welcome screen subtitle 'Nannu brings the pieces of your day together — privately.', Integrations intro 'Connect apps and services Nannu can read from...', and permissions.tsx/personalize.tsx strings confirmed via source grep (Nannu present, no leftover LifeOS). Backend: FastAPI app title correctly set to settings.APP_NAME='Nannu API' in config.py and used in server.py FastAPI() constructor; suggestion_engine.py system prompt updated to 'Nannu's quiet, explainable suggestion engine'. Regression: POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/me, GET /api/tasks, GET /api/health all return 200 for testuser@lifeos.app. Live UI flow: login -> Today dashboard renders (tasks, health cards, water suggestion) -> More hub -> Integrations screen -> Edit Profile screen, all render correctly with no broken layout. No functional regressions found; grep across all backend/frontend files in files_of_reference found zero remaining 'LifeOS' string in the specific lines touched.

minor.issue: Root-level /openapi.json returns 404 (Not Found) through the public ingress; only /docs (served at root, not /api/docs) returns 200. This is a pre-existing routing quirk unrelated to the rebrand (openapi title change could not be directly verified via curl due to this routing behavior, but confirmed by source code that FastAPI(title=settings.APP_NAME) correctly uses 'Nannu API').

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (not introduced by this rebrand change) RN-web hydration console warning: nested <button> descendant of <button> for HealthCard's inner 'Details' TouchableOpacity inside the outer card TouchableOpacity. Cosmetic console warning only, does not break interaction. Flagging for awareness, not a new regression.

critical_code_review_comments: app.json: bundleIdentifier/package still correctly reference 'com.emergent.lifeoshub.u2wtsc' (intentionally unchanged per instructions) while expo.name is 'Nannu' — correct scoped rename.
backend/core/config.py APP_NAME centralized as a single Settings constant, correctly referenced in server.py FastAPI(title=...) rather than hardcoded — good practice for future rebrand-proofing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 spot-checked endpoints: health, login, me, tasks)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested branding text + light regression flows verified

seed_data_creation: None — reused existing testuser@lifeos.app account, no new data created.
